title: Existence of the Koszul differential (left contraction by a linear form)
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $E$ an $R$-module, $\varphi:E\to R$ an $R$-linear map, and $\wedge(E)$ the exterior algebra of $E$ over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-exterior-algebra], with product $\wedge$ and unit $1$. Then there exists an $R$-linear map $D:\wedge(E)\to\wedge(E)$ such that $D(1)=0$ and $D(v\wedge x)=\varphi(v)\,x-v\wedge D(x)$ for all $v\in E$ and $x\in\wedge(E)$.
